gregory_vance.greeting: Make it quick, detective. I've got a building full of angry tenants and leaking boiler valves to deal with.

topics.label: Where were you between 11:00 PM and midnight?
topics.response: I told the uniform officer already: sub-basement boiler room. Boiler pressure was spiking on manifold four. I was down there with a pipe wrench until after midnight. You can check my maintenance log.

topics.label: How well did you know Timothy Vance?
topics.response: Mr. Vance kept to himself. Always in a suit, always carried a heavy briefcase. He paid his maintenance fee on the first of the month like clockwork. Never caused trouble.

topics.label: Could anyone have entered 4B without a key?
topics.response: Impossible. Those doors are solid oak with heavy brass deadbolts. If that thumbturn was thrown from the inside, nobody gets in without the police battering ram.

topics.label: About your financial troubles...
topics.response: Who gave you permission to snoop in my mail?! Look, my betting habits are my personal business. That doesn't make me a criminal.

topics.label: Explain the 11:40 PM freight elevator swipe.
topics.response: I... I told you what happened. A client paid me five grand to hold the freight lift. I was just following instructions, I swear I didn't lay hands on Mr. Vance!

corinne_blake.greeting: I hope you have a warrant or a very compelling reason to detain me, detective. My time is extremely valuable.

topics.label: Where were you around 11:30 PM?
topics.response: As I stated earlier, I was at home in my Greenwich townhouse. After dinner with Timothy at 7:30, I drove straight home and was tucked in with tea by 10:30 PM.

topics.label: What was the nature of your meeting with Timothy tonight?
topics.response: Routine quarterly asset allocations. We discussed municipal bond projections. Timothy was high-strung, as usual, but nothing out of the ordinary.

topics.label: He was auditing your offshore shell company, wasn't he?
topics.response: That audit was a preliminary internal draft! Timothy was misinterpreting standard capital repatriation structures. Accusing me of fraud is defamation, detective.

topics.label: We found your wet monogrammed umbrella in the lobby.
topics.response: I... I must have left it behind days ago. It rains frequently in November, surely that's not your entire case?

topics.label: Your car was parked in the basement at 11:15 PM.
topics.response: Fine! I went there to speak with him. I knocked on 4B at 11:20 PM, but he never answered. I swear I never stepped foot inside his flat!

toby_ray.greeting: Hey man, can we keep the siren lights down? I've got severe sensory migraine issues when mastering audio.

topics.label: What were you doing between 11:00 PM and midnight?
topics.response: I was wearing custom Beyerdynamic planar headphones with active noise cancellation, mixing a cinematic ambient drone score. Total sensory isolation, man.

topics.label: Did you ever interact with Timothy Vance?
topics.response: He complained once about bass frequencies vibrating his floorboards, so I put acoustic dampeners under my monitors. Otherwise, totally cordial guy.

topics.label: Why was your doorbell camera taped over?
topics.response: Hey, I value privacy! Landlords and supers are always walking the corridors. I don't need facial recognition logging my lifestyle.

topics.label: What was your microphone doing inside the 4B air vent?
topics.response: Look, I got offered cash to record room acoustics... alright, a corporate investigator paid me! But I never went inside his place!

topics.label: Tell us what your tape recorded at 11:38 PM.
topics.response: Track four has a woman's voice telling him to drink, then a collapse, then wheels rolling down the hall at 11:44 PM. The 11:47 PM panic alarm was totally staged!

dr_eleanor_sterling.greeting: Good evening, detective. How may I assist with Timothy's welfare? I am deeply concerned for my patient.

topics.label: Where were you at the time of the disappearance?
topics.response: I was at my private surgical clinic on East 68th Street all evening. I had multiple post-operative charts to review and update.

topics.label: When did you last speak with Timothy?
topics.response: He called my mobile at approximately 10:45 PM. He sounded remarkably agitated, complaining of chest constriction and insomnia. I urged him to drink warm chamomile tea and rest.

topics.label: Timothy's audit flagged your clinic for $2.4M in diverted funds.
topics.response: Timothy's accounting lacked context. Those funds were research endowments and specialized surgical equipment allocations. Completely lawful.

topics.label: You signed the lobby register as 'Dr. V. Martin' at 11:22 PM.
topics.response: I was providing confidential emergency palliative care to a patient who requested discretion. Timothy was agitated, so I gave him a mild prescription and left.

topics.label: A spent vial of Midazolam from your clinic was found in the basement.
topics.response: ...You have been exceedingly thorough, detective. But Timothy is unharmed. He was going to destroy everything I built for a clerical technicality.
